svg.title: Nyquist plots of a three-pole loop gain for a small and a large DC loop gain, zoomed near the origin; only the larger one encircles the point minus one
svg.text: Nyquist plot of a three-pole loop gain (zoomed near the origin)
red: βA0 = 69, crosses the axis at −2: encircles (−1, 0), unstable
blue: βA0 = 15.6, crosses at −0.45: no encirclement, stable
Loop gain βA0/[(1 + s)(1 + s/10)(1 + s/20)]. Solid: ω from 0 to +∞ (both curves start far
to the right at βA0); dashed: the mirror image for negative ω. The phase reaches −180° at
